about.title: Lompoc Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Lompoc's crash reports show a steady pattern: collisions cluster on corridors like Rt 1, H Street, Rt 246, and O Street, and Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. see more reported crashes than other times. With 90 injury collisions and 111 people hurt in the most recent final year of data, plus one traffic death, the numbers reflect real people dealing with medical bills, missed work, and insurance calls they didn't ask for. LawProactive isn't a law firm — we're a free service that connects Lompoc residents hurt in car accidents with an independent personal injury attorney in California who works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. Whether your crash happened near a busy intersection or a quieter stretch of road, getting matched with someone who can review your situation costs you nothing and takes just a few minutes.
commonInjuries: Cuts, bruises, and soft tissue injuries

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Settling

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, but that window shrinks to as little as six months if a government entity — like a city road crew — may share fault. Waiting too long can cost you the right to recover anything at all.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cut Your Recovery
items.desc: California allows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you're partly to blame, but your share of fault reduces your payout. An attorney can help make sure the insurer doesn't unfairly inflate your percentage of blame.

items.title: Don't Give a Recorded Statement Yet
items.desc: The other driver's insurer may ask for a recorded statement soon after the crash — it's not required, and anything you say can be used to limit your claim. Preserving evidence like photos, witness names, and medical records early matters more than talking to an adjuster fast.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover money. There's no upfront fee and no obligation to move forward after you're matched.

items.question: I was in a crash near H Street or O Street — does the location matter for my claim?
items.answer: The exact road matters less than what happened and who was involved, but knowing the corridor helps an attorney understand traffic patterns and available crash records for that stretch. Whether it was Rt 1, Rt 246, or a side street, what matters most is documenting the scene and your injuries as soon as possible.

items.question: What if the accident happened on a road maintained by the city or county?
items.answer: Claims involving government-maintained roads in California often have a much shorter deadline — sometimes just six months — to file a claim, compared to the standard two-year window. If a public road or vehicle might be involved, it's worth getting matched with an attorney quickly so that deadline isn't missed.
